verdict.rationale: Natural language is Skyvern's core interface. Tasks are driven by a natural-language goal prompt (skyvern-docs-18), and the SDK offers AI commands to act, extract and validate in plain language (skyvern-docs-19). Users can also describe an SOP in plain English to have a workflow built (skyvern-docs-24), use a copilot chat (skyvern-docs-25), or drive it from AI assistants via the MCP server (skyvern-docs-7). Hands-on use shows prompt-driven runs work on the happy path but can fail on unfamiliar UI elements like popups (skyvern-comm-2). Missing for 10: consistent reliability of natural-language execution on complex sites, and in-depth documentation of the copilot chat and SOP-to-workflow features.
